note: Opened the linked Virgo guide's body: it gives the tropical August 23–September 22 range and says the exact ingress can move with year and local time zone. This supports the bridge's statement that the range can shift by a day.
sentence: The same pattern of \"looks fixed, isn't\" shows up outside birthstones, too: [Virgo's date range](/virgo-dates/) can shift by a day between years and local time zones as the Sun’s entry into the sign falls at a different instant.

note: Opened the linked National Dog Day guide: its founding-history section distinguishes the widely repeated founder story from what the consulted record establishes. This supports the bridge's reminder to check what each account establishes.
sentence: It's been edited in pieces by a handful of trade groups over more than a century, the same way plenty of claims repeated as settled fact online, like [National Dog Day's founding story](/national-dog-day/), require checking what each account establishes.
